crossRefs.note: Therefore Mary took a pound of ointment of pure nard, very precious, and anointed Jesus’s feet and wiped his feet with…

translations.web: restraining her is like restraining the wind, or like grasping oil in his right hand.
translations.bsb: restraining her is like holding back the wind or grasping oil with one’s right hand.
translations.kjv: Whosoever hideth her hideth the wind, and the ointment of his right hand, which bewrayeth
translations.asv: He that would restrain her restraineth the wind; And his right hand encountereth oil.
